rv.q: Poulton, an accomplished adapter of Schiller, has created for the Royal Shakespeare Company two fast, darkly comic plays that have clearly learned from those earlier masters but will also not disappoint fans of modern political dramas such as House of Cards.
The intrigue fizzes, and the dialogue continually surprises, switching between delicious lyricism and a bracing simplicity.

cn.t: Mantel's acclaimed novels translate into a riveting theatrical experience, with fizzing intrigue and dialogue that switches between delicious lyricism and bracing simplicity.
